Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-110.json runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1
Now let's check diagnostics to see which pairs matter and where they separate.

Pair (0,1) dominates by far (support_product 0.226 vs next-highest 0.011). Its earliest high-separation slot is slot 4 (t=37.4754, sep=4.0σ), which also helps discriminate pair (0,5). Cursor thrift favors the earliest comparable-separation slot.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --slot 4 --why "Pair 0-1 dominates remaining support and separates by 4 sigma at slot 4, earliest such slot, so testing here first"

content.text: Candidate 0 jumped to 0.818 support, candidate 1 to 0.141. Not yet at theta=0.997. Let's re-check diagnostics.
Pair (0,1) still dominates. Earliest high-separation slot for it is slot 8 (t=43.1535, 4σ). Take that next.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --slot 8 --why "Pair 0-1 still dominant, slot 8 gives 4 sigma separation and is earliest reachable such slot"

content.text: Candidate 0 now at 0.954, still below theta=0.997. Pairs (0,3) and (0,4) are comparably close now — take earliest, slot 10, which also targets the higher support_product pair (0,3).

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --slot 10 --why "Candidate 0 leads but has not crossed theta, slot 10 gives 4 sigma separation against the next strongest rival pair 0-3 and is the earliest reachable option"

content.text: A surprise reversal — candidate 3 now leads at 0.792, candidate 4 at 0.208, candidate 0 collapsed. Let's re-diagnose.
Only pair (3,4) remains relevant now, support_product 0.165. Best full-separation (4σ) slot is 25 (t=61.4919) — earliest at max separation (slot 22 is 3.14σ, outside the ~20% comparability band).

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --slot 25 --why "Only pair 3-4 remains live, slot 25 gives full 4 sigma separation and is the earliest reachable slot at that strength"

content.text: Still contested — candidate 4 at 0.578, candidate 3 at 0.422. Two observations left. Re-check diagnostics.
Take slot 29 — earliest at full 4σ separation, still 1 observation in reserve for confirmation.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --slot 29 --why "Pair 3-4 remains the only contest, slot 29 is earliest reachable slot with full 4 sigma separation, keeping one slot in reserve to confirm"

content.text: Close but not yet crossed theta (0.997). One slot left — use it to try to cross the threshold.
Take the earliest, slot 30, at full 4σ separation for the last budgeted observation.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --slot 30 --why "Candidate 4 leads near theta but has not crossed it, final budgeted slot 30 gives full 4 sigma separation against remaining rival 3 and is earliest reachable"

content.text: Candidate 4 support is now 0.999976 ≥ theta (0.997). Resolved. Finalize.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v2-case-110-r1 --why "Candidate 4, period 17.16031 days, reached support 0.999976 which clears theta 0.997 after two confirming observations resolved the late 3-4 alias contest"

content.text:
Campaign complete and resolved.

**Summary — case-110 (run: `dev-v2-case-110-r1`)**

- Started with candidates 0/1 dominating support (0.52 / 0.43); observing slots 4 and 8 collapsed that contest onto candidate 0 (0.954 support) but it never crossed θ=0.997.
- A surprise at slot 10 completely reversed the picture, collapsing candidate 0 and elevating candidates 3/4 into the only live contest.
- Two more observations (slots 25, 29) tracked that late-emerging pair, converging on candidate 4 (period 17.16 days) at 0.990 support.
- Final budgeted observation (slot 30) confirmed the resolution: **candidate 4 selected, support 0.999976, all 6 observations used.**

This is a good illustration of why cursor thrift + reassessment matters — the early leader (candidate 0) was a false signal that only unraveled at slot 10, and there was still enough budget left to chase the true signal to a clean resolution.
